ownership.guest-init: PID 1 shell in tools/guest-builder/src/init; owns boot ordering, mounts, validation, reconciliation, retries, and markers
ownership.guest-runtime: Docker Engine/containerd/runc; owns Docker API, OCI lifecycle, workloads, and container resources
ownership.host-runtime: harpoon/Sources/VMManager.swift and bridge sources; owns VM configuration, serial observation, and host-side vsock/Unix bridges
ownership.builder: tools/guest-builder/build-initramfs.sh and release verification; owns artifact assembly and build-time closure checks

phases.failure: mount errors are mostly ignored; later phases may fail

phases.before: initramfs root is tmpfs/rootfs and /dev/vda may not exist
phases.after: ext4 modules loaded and /dev/vda mounted at /newroot, or diagnostic loop
phases.recovery: modprobe to ordered insmod; rw mount to ro mount; retry/wait loops

phases.after: Alpine root and kernel modules exist; repositories and second-stage /init seeded
phases.failure: logs populate errors but several copies are best-effort
phases.recovery: repopulate on a later boot if sentinel files remain absent

phases.before: persistent root may contain stale/modified immutable runtime payload
phases.after: init, management files, resize2fs closure, Python manifest and module closure match initramfs manifests
phases.recovery: atomic temp-copy/rename repair; fatal diagnostic loop if source or repair validation fails

phases.after: persistent ext4 root owns /proc, /sys, /dev and second-stage /init executes
phases.failure: HARPOON_PIVOT or root mount failure; fallback pivot_root path
phases.recovery: switch_root to pivot_root/chroot fallback; fatal loop on mount failure

phases.before: second-stage init running after root handoff
phases.after: root is non-tmpfs and Docker init begins

phases.before: block capacity and ext4 geometry may differ
phases.after: ext4 covers aligned device capacity, then a post-Docker size observation is emitted
phases.recovery: idempotent resize when needed; fatal loop on unreadable geometry or failed resize

phases.before: guest root is mounted; network modules may be absent
phases.after: bridge/NAT module closure loaded and IPv4 forwarding is 1
phases.recovery: continue after individual module errors, but fatal loop if forwarding is not enabled

phases.before: host shares and balloon device are configured by host but guest modules may not be loaded
phases.after: share mounts and balloon/memory observations are attempted
phases.failure: HARPOON_VIRTIOFS_FAILED or HARPOON_BALLOON_FAILED; host shares may be degraded
phases.recovery: best-effort share and balloon setup; no fatal loop for these failures

phases.before: virtio-net may not be present and no guest address is guaranteed
phases.after: interface has IPv4, DNS/HTTPS probes complete or diagnostics are emitted
phases.recovery: module fallback, DHCP wait, host-DNS/public-DNS override; fatal loop if no usable network/DNS

phases.before: network is available; persistent root may already contain required binaries
phases.recovery: offline skip when required binaries already exist; otherwise apk update/add; fatal loop if closure remains incomplete

phases.before: /run may contain stale runtime sockets/PIDs from a preserved root
phases.after: ephemeral /run exists with Docker/containerd directories and selected stale paths removed

phases.before: required binaries and /run are ready; Docker socket absent
phases.after: dockerd owns /var/run/docker.sock and docker info succeeds, or timeout/failure is recorded
phases.recovery: bounded 120-second poll; fatal path is reported after loop

phases.before: Docker API is ready; vsock kernel modules may be absent
phases.after: vsock 2375 forwards to Docker Unix socket and Docker bridge/NAT checks run
phases.recovery: modprobe to insmod; Python AF_VSOCK to socat fallback; fatal loop if vsock cannot be established

phases.before: Docker/vsock path is ready and management payload exists
phases.after: vsock 2377 runs wrapper to Python handler and HARPOON_MGMT_READY is emitted
phases.recovery: three listener attempts; fatal loop after exhaustion

phases.before: readiness paths have completed or failed
phases.after: process remains PID 1 and emits HARPOON_SPIKE_OK every two seconds
phases.failure: none; it can mask a completed boot as an infinite loop
